name: Law and Biopharmaceutical Sciences Minor
intro: The minor in Law and Biopharmaceutical Sciences studies the intersection of pharmaceutical and regulatory science and the legal system through examining contemporary issues related to the oversight, management, production and management of legal content from the perspective of science and pharmacy.

courses.title: Fundamentals of the U.S. Legal System
Issues in the Use of AI in Law and Regulation
Biopharmaceutical Product Development and Brand Planning
The Discovery, Development and Marketing of Medicines
Buzzed: Modern Substances of Abuse and Addiction
Medical Products: From Idea to Market
Management and Operation of Clinical Trials
Regulation, Guidance and Control of Medical Products
